hero.title: Turn Your Next Operational Challenge Into Better Software
hero.subtitle: Start a Conversation
hero.description: Tell us what is slowing your team down, what you want to automate, or what you want to build next. We turn real business workflows into focused software, SaaS and product experiences that are practical to run and ready to scale.

contactInfo.title: A direct line to our team
contactInfo.description: No complicated handoffs. Start with the channel that works best for you and we will take it from there.

methods.title: Email Us
methods.description: Best for project briefs, requirements and detailed questions

methods.title: Call Us
methods.description: Call during our usual collaboration hours

methods.title: Our Location
methods.description: Sri Lanka based, built for local and global delivery

form.title: Tell us what you are building
form.description: A little context helps us make the first conversation useful. Share what you know so far — rough ideas are welcome too.

fields.name: message
fields.label: Project Details
fields.placeholder: What are you trying to improve, replace or build? Tell us about the workflow, users and outcome you have in mind.

form.successMessage: Thanks — your project brief has been captured. We look forward to continuing the conversation.

cta.title: Not ready for a full brief? Start with one problem.
cta.description: Send us the bottleneck, manual process or product idea you want to improve. A focused first conversation is often enough to find the right direction.

features.title: Thoughtful first response
features.description: We start by understanding the workflow and outcome, not by forcing a predefined package.

features.title: Product-minded guidance
features.description: We can help shape scope, priorities and the simplest path from idea to a usable release.

features.title: Confidential by default
features.description: Sensitive project discussions can be handled under an NDA when required.

features.title: Sri Lanka based delivery
features.description: A local engineering team with the flexibility to collaborate with clients across time zones.
